judge.notes: Two has the clearest end-to-end launch narrative, strongest hierarchy, best composition variety, and the most useful relationships between diagrams, interface views, and concise copy. One is visually polished and cohesive with strong whitespace, but its sparse story and very small supporting text reduce clarity. Three is consistent but overly dark and repetitive, with several slides relying on tiny, low-contrast text and underdeveloped information relationships.
